description: Source code for AssetRepair class handling asset repair processes, including validation, stock management, GL entries, and depreciation schedule adjustments in an ERP system.

classes.name: AssetRepair
classes.description: Class managing asset repair lifecycle, including validation, stock handling, accounting entries, and depreciation schedule modifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates asset repair data and updates status.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates asset status based on repair status.

methods.name: set_total_value
methods.description: Calculates total value of stock items used in repair.

methods.name: calculate_total_repair_cost
methods.description: Calculates total repair cost including stock and repair costs.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Pre-submit hook to process asset value increase and depreciation schedule modifications.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Pre-cancel hook to revert asset value changes and depreciation schedule adjustments.

methods.name: check_repair_status
methods.description: Ensures repair status is updated before proceeding.

methods.name: check_for_stock_items_and_warehouse
methods.description: Validates presence of stock items and warehouse information.

methods.name: increase_asset_value
methods.description: Increases asset value based on stock consumption and repair costs.

methods.name: decrease_asset_value
methods.description: Decreases asset value based on stock consumption and repair costs.

methods.name: get_total_value_of_stock_consumed
methods.description: Calculates total value of consumed stock items.

methods.name: decrease_stock_quantity
methods.description: Creates and submits stock entry to decrease stock quantity.

methods.name: increase_stock_quantity
methods.description: Cancels stock entry to increase stock quantity.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for repair costs and stock consumption.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates GL entries for repair costs, stock consumption, and asset capitalization.

methods.name: modify_depreciation_schedule
methods.description: Adjusts depreciation schedule for increased asset life.

methods.name: calculate_last_schedule_date
methods.description: Calculates last schedule date when increasing asset life.

methods.name: revert_depreciation_schedule_on_cancellation
methods.description: Reverts depreciation schedule changes on cancellation.

methods.name: calculate_last_schedule_date_before_modification
methods.description: Calculates last schedule date when decreasing asset life.
